resources.string: A remote for this TV in your phone\'s browser
Open on your phone or computer:
QR code with the remote link
Control: confirm “Allow debugging” on the TV (tick “Always allow”)
Control: limited, ADB is not available
Turn on “Network debugging” in Developer options for the D-pad and all buttons, then come back here.
Text input: any language (accessibility service on)
Optional: turn on “Web TV Remote” in Accessibility to type in any language.
This settings screen is not available on this device
Lets Web TV Remote type text into the focused field and perform Back/Home when ADB is not available. It does not collect any data.
